Ability to interpret engineering drawings and technical documentation. This role is part of Datadog’s Security Agent team, which powers critical security capabilities across Workload Protection, Vulnerability Management, Cloud Security products, and other emerging security offerings. As a Staff Software Engineer, you will lead the design and development of low-level Linux instrumentation and runtime security technologies that help customers detect threats, monitor system activity, and protect cloud-native workloads at scale. You will work on complex technical challenges involving eBPF, Linux kernel internals, performance-sensitive systems, and large-scale data collection while influencing technical direction across multiple product teams. This role offers significant ownership, broad organizational impact, and the opportunity to shape the future of Datadog’s security platform.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What You’ll Do:

  • Lead the architecture and development of security agent capabilities that power runtime threat detection and workload protection across Datadog Security products.
  • Design and build reusable eBPF-based monitoring functionality for process, file, and network visibility within Linux environments.
  • Drive end-to-end delivery of new features, from technical strategy and design through implementation, testing, and rollout.
  • Establish and evolve testing methodologies that improve platform coverage, detection quality, reliability, and performance.
  • Partner with product, security, infrastructure, and engineering teams to deliver shared platform capabilities used across multiple Datadog products.
  • Provide technical leadership by influencing engineering direction, mentoring peers, and helping resolve complex cross-functional challenges.

Who You Are:

  • You have significant experience building software in Linux environments, including knowledge of Linux internals, kernel APIs, or systems programming.
  • You have hands-on experience with eBPF, kernel-level instrumentation, driver development, networking systems, agent development, or related low-level technologies.
  • You've built and run systems where performance and reliability actually matter.
  • You have experience building and maintaining production software across diverse Linux distributions and kernel versions.
  • You are product-minded and customer-focused, balancing technical excellence with customer impact and usability.

Datadog is the leading observability and security platform for the AI era, providing businesses with unified visibility across the technology stack to manage complexity at scale. It brings applications, infrastructure, data, models, and security into one place, using AI to detect and resolve issues before they impact customers. 64fb2fba027fc435.description:
About Chargebee
Chargebee is a leading provider of billing and monetization solutions, empowering businesses with recurring revenue models to streamline revenue and finance operations, capture actionable insights, and drive growth.
Chargebee is trusted by businesses of all sizes, including Zapier, LegalZoom, Lambda, Freshworks, DeepL, Condé Nast, and Pret a Manger, and is proud to have been consistently recognized by customers as a Leader in Subscription Management on G2.
With headquarters in North Bethesda, Maryland, our team members are based primarily in India, the U.S., and Europe.

About the Team
Chargebee's Platform Product & Engineering teams are responsible for ensuring our technical platform and infrastructure meets the expectations of businesses who rely on Chargebee to run their most important revenue operations. These businesses depend on our technical platform to be robust, extensible, performant, reliable, stable, secure and scalable in order to process billions of dollars (and Euros, and other currencies) worth of transactions with enterprise-class service levels. Our Platform Product Managers make sure we consistently meet and exceed what merchants expect of our technical platform, working closely with engineering and technical and non-technical operations teams to do so.

About the role (Job Summary)
As a member of the platform product team, you will support our ongoing strategic focus on modernizing our platform — a series of initiatives in which we are investing significant resources. We're building a microservice architecture that powers a series of loosely-coupled capabilities used across Chargebee's product lines. Our modernized platform will support throughputs an order of magnitude higher than our legacy platform, with lower latency and higher service levels and will be built to enable rapid development cycles with built-in trust and integrity controls. The modernized platform runs on a standardized and abstract cloud fabric. In addition to runtime transactional components, the modernized platform will also include enterprise data management (including data science and machine learning applications), observability and analytical, and developer productivity components.

What you'll do (role and responsibilities)
Drive planning and prioritization for your feature area within a platform domain, define and track key metrics, and work closely with engineers to define feature functionality and execute against the roadmap.
• You'll focus on one or more of the following domains: APIs (endpoints & contracts, workflows, orchestration, frameworks and infrastructure); core platform services (including IAM, queue and job management, auditing, search, notifications, etc.) and service frameworks; transactional data management, enterprise data, DS/ML, and analytical systems; cloud fabric (containers, compute, storage, etc.); path-to-production (build, quality, release gates, automated testing and validation, deployment); observability, telemetry, proactive platform health management and incident processes; and platform initiatives (security, privacy/data protection; technical standards and governance and SLAs/SLOs).
• Engage with internal partner teams (and external customers, where relevant) to gather product requirements and feedback through discussions, presentations, and preview programs, and translate that input into clear, detailed requirements.
• Own the product lifecycle for your assigned features and services end to end — from discovery through requirements, build, launch, and iteration — shipping consistently against an established roadmap.
• As you build fluency in your domain, increasingly help shape near-term roadmap decisions for your feature area in partnership with Staff and Principal PMs, making sure your recommendations align with the broader platform strategy they've set.
• Manage the product lifecycle for your feature area, working with cross-functional partners (technical and non-technical) to solve concrete problems faced by Chargebee, our developers, merchants, and our merchants' end users.
• Communicate progress, trade-offs, and value delivered clearly to your immediate stakeholders and cross-functional partners.
• Conduct technical product discovery at the feature level: understand customer needs (internal and external) and technical constraints well enough to write sound requirements and make day-to-day prioritization calls.
• Create detailed product requirements and acceptance criteria (within Agile Kanban or Scrum processes); manage your portion of the roadmap; prioritize within your assigned feature area.
• Working with an analytics partner, track the input and output metrics (technical and business) relevant to your feature area and report on progress.
• Working with a program management partner, follow operational processes and support staged, incremental roll-out plans.
• Help uphold SLAs and SLOs relevant to your feature area.
• Operate with growing autonomy within a matrix environment; escalate and help resolve blockers, and build strong working relationships across engineering, program management, and operations.

What you'll bring (required skills and experience)
• Domain-appropriate knowledge: e.g., APIs (REST, GraphQL, etc.); streaming, OLTP and OLAP data systems; service frameworks; CI/CD, etc. (You are not expected to have full domain depth on day one; you should be a fast learner.)
• Foundational systems thinking: ability to understand how the parts of a technical system fit together at the feature/service level, with growing ability to reason at a broader system level.
• Background in platform product management with 5-8+ years of practical experience.
• Strong written and oral communication skills; ability to listen and understand what drives people.
• Experience working in a remote, distributed, global (cross-time-zone) company in a rapidly changing business environment, or a strong willingness and ability to adapt to one.
• Ability to work with ambiguity and in gray spaces, with support from more senior PMs.
• Solid critical thinking, problem-solving, and analytical skills.
• Experience with ecommerce, SaaS, or related software applications running on the internet; exposure to complex/distributed systems and cloud technologies (e.g., AWS, Kubernetes, etc.) is a plus.
• Experience or demonstrated ability collaborating with cross-functional teams outside your reporting line.
• Past experience as a software developer or SDET, or equivalent technical exposure, is a plus.
• Higher education in a technical field (CS, EE, Information Systems) or equivalent experience.

Benefits we offer
At Chargebee, we believe that feeling supported is the foundation for doing great work. We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your personal, financial, and professional growth and ensure you thrive in every aspect of your life. About Business line/Function: Under BNP Paribas IT Group, ITTF FRS is the IT framework encompassing Projects & Systems of Finance and RISK functions, with a strong focus on efficiency, proximity, agility and time-to-market.

FRS is a worldwide organizational model that will contribute to tackle major challenges of the Group’s transformation of today and tomorrow, building the best offering to the Finance and Risk Community through a progressive rotation to new technologies and best practices. The FRS organization is the outcome of several convergences: between the Project & Systems teams of Group Finance, CIB Finance and RISK and their related IT teams.

FRS is part of the IT Group organization (ITG in Europe and ITO overseas) with a threefold sponsorship by ITG, Finance and RISK (CIB-ITO; RISK Solutions and ITG-FIT).

About BNP Paribas Group

BNP Paribas is the European Union’s leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking & Services for the Group’s commercial & personal banking and several specialized businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment & Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate & Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. Based on its strong diversified and integrated model, the Group helps all its clients (individuals, community associations, entrepreneurs, SMEs, corporates and institutional clients) to realize their projects through solutions spanning financing, investment, savings and protection insurance. In Europe, BNP Paribas has four domestic markets: Belgium, France, Italy, and Luxembourg. The Group is rolling out its integrated commercial & personal banking model across several Mediterranean countries, Turkey, and Eastern Europe. As a key player in international banking, the Group has leading platforms and business lines in Europe, a strong presence in the Americas as well as a solid and fast-growing business in Asia-Pacific. BNP Paribas has implemented a Corporate Social Responsibility approach in all its activities, enabling it to contribute to the construction of a sustainable future, while ensuring the Group's performance and stability.

Established in 2005, BNP Paribas India Solutions is a wholly owned subsidiary of BNP Paribas SA, European Union’s leading bank with an international reach. With delivery centers located in Bengaluru, Chennai and Mumbai, we are a 24x7 global delivery center. India Solutions services three business lines: Corporate and Institutional Banking, Investment Solutions and Retail Banking for BNP Paribas across the Group. Driving innovation and growth, we are harnessing the potential of over 10000 employees, to provide support and develop best-in-class solutions.
